title: Vidrio Espejoyuq Palacio
intro: Piensariy karu-karu qhapaq hinaspa sumaqllaña allpapi, chaypim intita yupaychanku Kamaqninpa rantinpi. Huk carta chayan mana mana uyariy atina waqyakuywan, hinaspan huk viaje qallarikun huk tribunalman, ñawpaq rikusqamanta aswan hatun tribunalman. Chaypin ilusión nisqa rikukunqa ñawikunata q’otuq pampawan, huk ratu sut’i kayqa tukuy imatan cambianqa.
clues: Huk qhapaq hallp’apin kamachirqani, chay hallp’an runakunan Allahpa rantinpi intiman k’umuykukuqku.
Huk noble cartata chaskirqani, chaypin waqyawarqan ama hatunchakunaypaq aswanpas Allahman kasukuspa hamunaypaq.
Consejoyta tapurqani hinaspam puntata diplomaciata akllarqani, huk regalota apachirqani kachaqta pruebanaypaq.
Sulayman llaqtaman hamurqani, kikiypa tronoytataqmi disfrazasqata presentawarqanku reqsisqa kayta pruebanaypaq.
Huk alto palaciomanmi haykurqani, chaypa llañu vidrio pampantam pantarqani uku yakuwan.
Sulaymanwan kuska Allahman, kay pachakunaq Señorninman, entregakusqaytan willarqani.

Sulaymanwan kuska Allahman, pachakunaq Señorninman entregasqa

outcome.answer: Sulaymanwan kuska Allahman, pachakunaq Señorninman entregasqa

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
